name: 32383-batchdecode-gemma34b-1gpu
model: unsloth/gemma-3-4b-it -- an ungated mirror of the licence-gated `google/gemma-3-4b-it`, identical on every config field the engine reads.
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3, one node, no router and no external cache tier
parallelism: tp1, pp1, dp1, ep1. Single-GPU is part of the declaration; do not shard it.
architecture: Gemma3ForConditionalGeneration, 4.3 B parameters, bf16, ~8.6 GB of safetensors; the repository's SigLIP vision tower is loaded but never entered by this text-only workload.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=16, warmup the first 20%, bounded at 3200 requests with a 2400 s safety cap.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, single turn, no shared prefix, seed 42. Prompts exactly 512 tokens and generations exactly 64 tokens (both stdev 0) with `ignore_eos: true` at `temperature: 0.0`, so every request is one prefill step and 64 decode steps.
purpose: A compact 4-billion-parameter chat assistant giving short replies to half-page prompts for 16 concurrent users on one GPU.
launch:
# sglang at the commit named by configs/setupcard.md `commit_id`.
#
# Flat `key: value` only -- nested blocks are dropped. A bool is a FLAG: `true` emits
# `--key`, `false` emits nothing. Environment variables cannot live here.

# `unsloth/` is an ungated mirror of `google/gemma-3-4b-it` (same weights; the Gemma Terms of Use
# apply). Dispatch is on `architectures` / `model_type`, never on the id.
model-path: unsloth/gemma-3-4b-it

tp-size: 1

# fa3 is what this engine selects unaided on an SM90 card at this commit, and bfloat16 is the
# checkpoint's own dtype; both are pinned so no future default can change them. The checkpoint
# advertises 131072 positions and the longest request here is 576 tokens, hence 4096.
attention-backend: fa3
dtype: bfloat16
context-length: 4096

# Synthetic prompts are not guaranteed to avoid a shared leading run of tokens, and a radix hit
# lets a request skip its prefill. Off means every request pays for its own.
disable-radix-cache: true

# Everything else is stock, CUDA graphs included (ON) -- the declared operating point is the
# captured decode path. The engine derives a decode capture bound of 256 for TP<4 on an 80 GB
# card, so walk the stream count up to 256 and not past it.
